en: The image is a vintage black-and-white postcard depicting a busy street scene with people in period clothing, trees, and several multi-story buildings with shops and signage. The street scene is lively, with people walking, talking, and shopping. The style and dress suggest an early 20th-century European city. The text 'Király-uteza.' and 'Pécs.' are visible, with additional signage and writing on the buildings and along the left border.
